title: fix(play): prove.headers-carry-their-weight is red — 8 headers outweigh their bodies
description:
# 🌙 dream: `prove.headers-carry-their-weight` is red — 8 headers outweigh their bodies

kind: repair · owner: this repo · caught 2026-10-30, in 5.3.verification of #174 · red main

## .the cue that fired
a full `rhx play.run --all` on the tailscale branch: `💥 prove.headers-carry-their-weight — failed
(exit 1)`. none of the 8 files is in that pr's diff, so the play is red on main.

## .the gap, precisely
the bar: a phase ≤ 55% comment and ≤ 250 lines; an `_.sh` ≤ 40 comment lines. over it:

| file (under `src/grove.provision/`) | reads |
|---|---|
| `1.system/1.11.wifi/_.sh` | 56% comment |
| `1.system/1.1.keybinds/configure.upsert.sh` | 62% comment |
| `1.system/1.6.procs/1.6.3.earlyoom/_.sh` | 71% comment |
| `1.system/1.6.procs/1.6.6.abandoned/_.sh` | 61% comment |
| `1.system/1.6.procs/_.sh` | 47 comment lines |
| `2.shell/2.7.aliases/configure.verify.sh` | 290 lines |
| `5.devtools/5.18.openhours/provision.upsert.sh` | 263 lines |
| `5.devtools/5.18.openhours/_.sh` | 69% comment |

the cause: each header grew narrative — measurements, incident accounts, edit history — past the
`.what` + `.why` outline `rule.forbid.narratives` allows.

## .the shape of the fix
- per file: cut the header to a one-line `.what` and one-sentence `.why` bullets; rehome each
  narrative or measurement into the brief that owns its subject, and cite it by name
- the two long files (`2.7.aliases/configure.verify.sh`, `5.18.openhours/provision.upsert.sh`):
  split the body by claim into peer functions in the bundle's `_.sh`, or move comment mass out;
  the line bar is on the file, not its comments
- done when `rhx play.run --play prove.headers-carry-their-weight` exits 0, and each touched
  bundle passes plan-apply-apply on a grove

## .why it is not done in the round that found it
the tailscale tree touches none of these files; the fix opens wifi, keybinds, procs, aliases, and
openhours. a separate tree takes it.
